hint: Plan and procure: record the demand and specification, have it approved by someone other than the requester, enter the purchase order number when ordering, then book each delivered asset against its line. Differences from the order are refused unless accepted with a reason.
title: Title
poNumberPlaceholder: Purchase order number (needed to mark as ordered)
acceptReason: Why the difference is accepted (at least 5 characters)
booked: The asset was booked against the order.

poFile.title: Purchase order document
poFile.hint: PDF, Word, Excel, text or CSV, up to 10 MB.
poFile.tooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB.
poFile.failedAfterOrder: The request is marked as ordered, but the purchase order document could not be uploaded. Use Upload PO to try again.

levels.title: Approval levels
levels.hint: A purchase request is approved level by level, in this order. Each level is decided by a member of its role (or any approver if no role is set), never by the requester, and never by someone who already approved an earlier level. One rejection ends the request. With no levels, one approver is enough. The approvers need access to the Lifecycle section. Changes apply to requests submitted from now on.
levels.none: No levels set: one approver decides.
levels.name: Level name, e.g. Plant head
